source.scope: Selected earned Berserker3–5, extra skill, Frenzy and bounded explicit Primal Knowledge Strength checks; level4 ordinary non-DEX ASI with conditional canonical-AC CON admission; level5 Extra Attack (Attack-action allowance) and Fast Movement (+10 ft Speed with the verified unarmored state, never in Heavy armor).
